writeup_draft.motivation: Autonomy systems fail when they only work on distributions they have already seen. 0xDriver treats minimal-shot driving as an evaluation and orchestration problem: generate plausible out-of-distribution pressure cases, run frozen policies through the same artifact contract, and preserve the failures as retrieval memory.
writeup_draft.architecture: The current implementation builds deterministic scenario recipes, exports route-compatible CARLA/Bench2Drive artifacts, plans companion overlay actors, bundles route evidence, and tracks policy readiness. A retrieval layer can guide local policy decisions today, while SimLingo and Alpamayo remain swappable live-policy adapters.
writeup_draft.what_worked: The local harness is reproducible: generated suite status is `blocked`, policy runtime ready rows are `5`, and the Alpamayo probe status is `model_loaded`. The live Alpamayo memory comparison changed trajectory final L2 by `2.8886` metres while staying explicitly open-loop.
writeup_draft.what_did_not_work: The current named failure is `Live route video exists, but the bounded smoke run has no completed route score or route completion.`. This blocks a polished live route video but gives a precise next step instead of an ambiguous model-quality claim.
writeup_draft.next_funding_step: Use the prize budget for a graphics-capable NVIDIA CARLA host, a confirmed reasoning-VLA checkpoint/runtime, and enough GPU hours to run generated OOD suites closed-loop with video, latency, infractions, and failure-memory comparisons.
